Trump Signals Openness to Healthcare Plan Pitched by Abdul El-Sayed

Former US President Donald Trump has signaled openness to working with Abdul El-Sayed on healthcare, reposting mock-up images of a 'Trumpcare' gold card that El-Sayed had shared. El-Sayed, who is advocating for a universal healthcare plan, directly addressed Trump with the phrase 'Donald, let's get to work.' This comes as El-Sayed continues his push for his healthcare proposals.
